# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

# Store Network Notes



Team,

Here is the short version of how the PowerTool Central Europe branch map got to its current shape.

We started with the Vienna Praterstern branch in 2017, serving trade customers who needed a central Vienna pickup point near the rail hub. The Vienna Meidling branch followed in 2019 after west-side crews kept losing time crossing town; when a customer says the west-side Vienna PowerTool shop, they mean Meidling, not Praterstern.

Graz came next. Jakomini opened in 2020 as our central Graz store, close enough to the inner-city job sites to act as the default Graz branch. Lend opened in 2022 to cover the north side of Graz and the routes coming in from that direction. In Graz language, north Graz means Lend; central Graz means Jakomini.

In 2023 we added Linz Hauptplatz and Salzburg Elisabeth-Vorstadt. Linz is the main-square branch. Salzburg Elisabeth-Vorstadt is the station-side branch, so local notes may call it the shop near Salzburg station.

In 2024 we opened Innsbruck Wilten and Bratislava Stare Mesto. Wilten is our central Innsbruck store for practical dispatch purposes. Stare Mesto is the old-town Bratislava branch.

The newest 2025 additions are Brno Veveri and Ljubljana Center. Veveri is our central Brno branch. Ljubljana Center is the downtown Ljubljana shop.

When several stores share a city, use the city nuance above before checking inventory. Inventory itself remains in the SQL projection, keyed by the store IDs from the JSON files in this directory.

Store JSON records include generated branch coordinates for payment-risk and distance checks.

# Payments

Generated payment records live here. Current payment files represent one payment attempt for a `checked_out` basket.

Older payments may have `basket_archived: true`. Those basket records have aged out of `/proc/baskets/` into cold storage, so the payment file carries its own `lines` snapshot with SKU, quantity, and unit price.

Payment statuses are compact:

- `paid`: payment completed successfully.
- `requires_3ds_action`: payment is stuck in the simulated 3DS workflow.

Stuck payments include a `three_ds` object with legacy challenge status, failure reason, attempts, and maximum attempts. The `three_ds.status` values intentionally use inherited 3DS codes; consult the payment policy before deciding whether a payment can be recovered.

Payment fingerprints are opaque instrument/device identifiers. `observed_lat` and `observed_lon` are checkout-time coordinates from the payment risk log, not a customer address.

# Employees

Generated employee profiles live here. Every store gets the same fixed roster shape:

- one `General Store Manager` with roles `employee`, `store_manager`, `discount_manager`, `refund_manager`, `inventory_viewer`, `fulfillment_viewer`, and `customer_service`
- one `Inventory Specialist` with roles `employee`, `inventory_specialist`, `inventory_viewer`, and `stock_adjuster`
- one `Fulfillment Coordinator` with roles `employee`, `fulfillment_coordinator`, `fulfillment_operator`, and `inventory_viewer`
- two `Customer Service Associate` employees with roles `employee`, `customer_service`, `order_viewer`, and `discount_requester`

Employee records include `email`, `roles`, and `title` for identity and authorization lookup tasks.

# Customers

Generated customer profiles live here. The customer id from `/bin/id` can be matched against these records.

Customer records include `email` for contact identity and lookup tasks. `home_lat` and `home_lon` are coarse generated home-area coordinates used by payment-risk fixtures.

# Baskets

Generated customer baskets live here. Basket files list customer, store, lifecycle status, and requested line items.

Basket records include `created_at`, generated from world time, so tasks can refer to basket recency such as "the last basket".

Baskets do not carry availability flags; compare basket lines with store inventory when checkout eligibility matters.

Discounted baskets carry a `discount` object with `percent`, `reason_code`, and `issuer_id`.

Basket status is lifecycle state. `active` baskets may still need inventory checks before checkout; `checked_out` baskets are historical orders and may have linked records under `/proc/payments/` and `/proc/returns/`.

	employee_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	record_path TEXT NOT NULL,
	employee_display_name TEXT NOT NULL,

	FOREIGN KEY (store_id) REFERENCES stores(store_id)

)"
payment_transaction_items,"CREATE TABLE payment_transaction_items (
	payment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	line_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
	product_sku TEXT NOT NULL,
	purchased_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
	item_unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY (payment_id, line_number),
	FOREIGN KEY (payment_id) REFERENCES payment_transactions(payment_id),
	FOREIGN KEY (product_sku) REFERENCES product_variants(product_sku)
)"
payment_transactions,"CREATE TABLE payment_transactions (
	payment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	record_path TEXT NOT NULL,
	basket_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	is_archived_basket_reference INTEGER NOT NULL,
	customer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	store_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	payment_amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
	payment_currency TEXT NOT NULL,
	payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
	payment_created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	payment_method_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
	device_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
	observed_latitude REAL NOT NULL,
	observed_longitude REAL NOT NULL,
	three_ds_status TEXT,
	three_ds_failure_reason TEXT,
	three_ds_attempts INTEGER,
	three_ds_max_attempts INTEGER,
	FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customer_accounts(customer_id),
	FOREIGN KEY (store_id) REFERENCES stores(store_id)
)"
product_categories,"CREATE TABLE product_categories (
	product_category_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	product_category_name TEXT NOT NULL,
	product_department TEXT NOT NULL
)"

	product_family_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	product_category_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	product_kind_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	brand TEXT NOT NULL,
	series TEXT NOT NULL,
	model TEXT NOT NULL,
	product_family_name TEXT NOT NULL,
	properties TEXT NOT NULL
)"
product_kinds,"CREATE TABLE product_kinds (
	product_kind_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	product_category_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	product_kind_name TEXT NOT NULL
)"
product_variant_properties,"CREATE TABLE product_variant_properties (
	product_sku TEXT NOT NULL,
	property_key TEXT NOT NULL,
	property_value_text TEXT NOT NULL,
	property_value_number REAL,
	PRIMARY KEY (product_sku, property_key)
)"
product_variants,"CREATE TABLE product_variants (
	product_sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	record_path TEXT NOT NULL,
	product_category_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	product_kind_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	product_family_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	brand TEXT NOT NULL,
	series TEXT NOT NULL,
	model TEXT NOT NULL,
	product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
	price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
	price_currency TEXT NOT NULL,
	properties TEXT NOT NULL
)"
return_requests,"CREATE TABLE return_requests (
	return_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	record_path TEXT NOT NULL,
	basket_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	customer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	payment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	return_status TEXT NOT NULL,
	return_reason_code TEXT NOT NULL,
	return_created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (basket_id) REFERENCES shopping_baskets(basket_id),
	FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customer_accounts(customer_id),
	FOREIGN KEY (payment_id) REFERENCES payment_transactions(payment_id)
)"
shopping_basket_items,"CREATE TABLE shopping_basket_items (
	basket_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	line_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
	product_sku TEXT NOT NULL,
	requested_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY (basket_id, line_number),
	FOREIGN KEY (basket_id) REFERENCES shopping_baskets(basket_id),
	FOREIGN KEY (product_sku) REFERENCES product_variants(product_sku)
)"
shopping_baskets,"CREATE TABLE shopping_baskets (
	basket_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	record_path TEXT NOT NULL,
	customer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	store_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	basket_status TEXT NOT NULL,
	basket_created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	discount_percent INTEGER,
	discount_reason_code TEXT,
	discount_issuer_employee_id TEXT,
	FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customer_accounts(customer_id),
	FOREIGN KEY (store_id) REFERENCES stores(store_id)
)"
store_inventory,"CREATE TABLE store_inventory (
	store_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	product_sku TEXT NOT NULL,
	on_hand_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
	reserved_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
	available_today_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
	incoming_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
	next_arrival_in_days INTEGER,
	PRIMARY KEY (store_id, product_sku),
	FOREIGN KEY (store_id) REFERENCES stores(store_id),
	FOREIGN KEY (product_sku) REFERENCES product_variants(product_sku)
)"
stores,"CREATE TABLE stores (
	store_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	record_path TEXT NOT NULL,
	store_name TEXT NOT NULL,
	city TEXT NOT NULL,
	is_open INTEGER NOT NULL,
	latitude REAL NOT NULL,
	longitude REAL NOT NULL
)"

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

SELECT DISTINCT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
FROM product_variants pv
JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = si.store_id
WHERE pv.product_kind_id = 'cordless_drill_driver'
  AND s.city = 'Ljubljana'
  AND s.is_open = 1
  AND si.available_today_quantity > 0
ORDER BY pv.product_sku;
SELECT store_id, record_path FROM stores WHERE city='Innsbruck' AND is_open=1;

WITH target_store AS (
  SELECT store_id, store_name, record_path
  FROM stores
  WHERE store_name LIKE '%Innsbruck%' AND store_name LIKE '%Wilten%'
),
p1 AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_variant_properties a ON a.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND a.property_key='fastener_type' AND LOWER(a.property_value_text)='bolt'
  JOIN product_variant_properties b ON b.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND b.property_key='diameter' AND (b.property_value_text='10 mm' OR b.property_value_text='10mm')
  WHERE pv.brand='Heco' AND pv.series='Heco Zinc Plated' AND pv.model='HECO 3DW-64B' AND pv.product_kind_id='nut_bolt_washer'
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_variant_properties a ON a.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND a.property_key='cleaner_type' AND LOWER(a.property_value_text)='degreaser'
  WHERE pv.brand='Ajax' AND pv.series='Ajax Eco Classic' AND pv.model='25C-DXE' AND pv.product_kind_id='cleaning_liquid'
),
p3 AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_variant_properties a ON a.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND a.property_key='screw_type' AND LOWER(a.property_value_text)='drywall screw'
  WHERE pv.brand='Heco' AND pv.series='Heco Zinc Plated TopFix' AND pv.model='GTU-YPJ' AND pv.product_kind_id='wood_drywall_screw'
),
p4 AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_variant_properties a ON a.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND a.property_key='screw_type' AND LOWER(a.property_value_text)='wood screw'
  JOIN product_variant_properties b ON b.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND b.property_key='diameter' AND (b.property_value_text='3 mm' OR b.property_value_text='3mm')
  WHERE pv.brand='Heco' AND pv.series='Heco Zinc Plated TopFix' AND pv.model='GTU-YPJ' AND pv.product_kind_id='wood_drywall_screw'
)
SELECT 'store' AS row_type, ts.store_id AS c1, ts.store_name AS c2, ts.record_path AS c3
FROM target_store ts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'p1', product_sku, record_path, '' FROM p1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'p2', product_sku, record_path, '' FROM p2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'p3', product_sku, record_path, '' FROM p3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'p4', product_sku, record_path, '' FROM p4;

Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

  WHERE pv.brand='Fiskars'

    AND pk.product_kind_name='Chainsaw'

q3 AS (
  SELECT 'P3' AS pid, pv.product_sku AS sku, pv.record_path AS path, si.available_today_quantity AS avail

WITH target_store AS (
  SELECT 'store_vienna_meidling' AS store_id
),
checks AS (
  SELECT 'P1' AS product_key, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id = pv.product_kind_id
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id
  WHERE pv.brand='Karcher' AND pv.series='Karcher WD SC' AND pv.model='1PM-1UM'
    AND pk.product_kind_name='Cleaning Liquid'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='cleaner_type' AND LOWER(p.property_value_text)=LOWER('degreaser'))

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P2', pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id = pv.product_kind_id
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id
  WHERE pv.brand='Pattex' AND pv.series='Pattex Universal Repair' AND pv.model='56O-393'
    AND pk.product_kind_name='Sealant'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='sealant_type' AND LOWER(p.property_value_text)=LOWER('silicone sealant'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='color_family' AND LOWER(p.property_value_text)=LOWER('Clear'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='volume' AND REPLACE(LOWER(p.property_value_text),' ','')=REPLACE(LOWER('280 ml'),' ',''))

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P3', pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id = pv.product_kind_id
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id
  WHERE pv.brand='Helios' AND pv.series='Helios Quick Dry Mobihel' AND pv.model='1VV-8Y1'
    AND pk.product_kind_name='Wall Paint'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='color_family' AND LOWER(p.property_value_text)=LOWER('Black'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='finish' AND LOWER(p.property_value_text)=LOWER('satin'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='volume' AND REPLACE(LOWER(p.property_value_text),' ','')=REPLACE(LOWER('2500 ml'),' ',''))

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P4', pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id = pv.product_kind_id
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id
  WHERE pv.brand='Osram' AND pv.series='Osram Eco Classic' AND pv.model='3PW-R88'
    AND pk.product_kind_name='LED Bulb'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='wattage' AND REPLACE(LOWER(p.property_value_text),' ','')=REPLACE(LOWER('4 W'),' ',''))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='luminous_flux' AND REPLACE(LOWER(p.property_value_text),' ','')=REPLACE(LOWER('806 lm'),' ',''))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='fitting' AND LOWER(p.property_value_text)=LOWER('E27'))

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P5', pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id = pv.product_kind_id
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id
  WHERE pv.brand='Wurth' AND pv.series='Wurth Universal WU' AND pv.model='30Y-BPU'
    AND pk.product_kind_name='Nut Bolt and Washer'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='fastener_type' AND LOWER(p.property_value_text)=LOWER('threaded rod'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='diameter' AND REPLACE(LOWER(p.property_value_text),' ','')=REPLACE(LOWER('6 mm'),' ',''))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='length' AND REPLACE(LOWER(p.property_value_text),' ','')=REPLACE(LOWER('40 mm'),' ',''))

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P6', pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id = pv.product_kind_id
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id
  WHERE pv.brand='Tesa' AND pv.series='Tesa Powerbond Powerbond' AND pv.model='1RD-FPW'
    AND pk.product_kind_name='Tape and Foam'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='product_type' AND LOWER(p.property_value_text)=LOWER('construction foam'))
)
SELECT product_key, product_sku, record_path, available_today_quantity,
       CASE WHEN available_today_quantity >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qualifies
FROM checks
ORDER BY product_key;

SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.brand, pv.series, pv.model, pv.product_name, pvp.property_key, pvp.property_value_text, pvp.property_value_number
FROM product_variants pv
LEFT JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku
WHERE pv.brand='Ajax' AND pv.model='25C-DXE'
ORDER BY pv.product_sku, pvp.property_key
LIMIT 300;

SELECT product_sku, record_path, brand, series, model, product_name
FROM product_variants
WHERE model LIKE '%25C%' OR model LIKE '%DXE%' OR lower(product_name) LIKE '%ajax%' OR lower(series) LIKE '%ajax%' OR lower(product_name) LIKE '%cleaning liquid%'
ORDER BY brand, model
LIMIT 200;

request.stdin:
WITH fam AS (
  SELECT pv.brand, pv.series, pv.model, pk.product_kind_name, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.properties
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id=pv.product_kind_id
  WHERE (pv.brand='Karcher' AND pv.series='WD' AND pv.model='SC 1PM-1UM' AND pk.product_kind_name='Cleaning Liquid')
     OR (pv.brand='Pattex' AND pv.series='Universal' AND pv.model='Repair 56O-393' AND pk.product_kind_name='Sealant')
     OR (pv.brand='Helios' AND pv.series='Quick Dry' AND pv.model='Mobihel 1VV-8Y1' AND pk.product_kind_name='Wall Paint')
     OR (pv.brand='Osram' AND pv.series='Eco' AND pv.model='Classic 3PW-R88' AND pk.product_kind_name='LED Bulb')
     OR (pv.brand='Wurth' AND pv.series='Universal WU' AND pv.model='30Y-BPU' AND pk.product_kind_name='Nut Bolt and Washer')
     OR (pv.brand='Tesa' AND pv.series='Powerbond Powerbond' AND pv.model='1RD-FPW' AND pk.product_kind_name='Tape and Foam')
)
SELECT f.brand, f.series, f.model, f.product_kind_name, f.product_sku, f.record_path,
       json_extract(f.properties,'$.cleaner_type') AS cleaner_type,
       json_extract(f.properties,'$.sealant_type') AS sealant_type,
       json_extract(f.properties,'$.color_family') AS color_family,
       json_extract(f.properties,'$.volume') AS volume,
       json_extract(f.properties,'$.finish') AS finish,
       json_extract(f.properties,'$.wattage') AS wattage,
       json_extract(f.properties,'$.luminous_flux') AS luminous_flux,
       json_extract(f.properties,'$.fitting') AS fitting,
       json_extract(f.properties,'$.fastener_type') AS fastener_type,
       json_extract(f.properties,'$.diameter') AS diameter,
       json_extract(f.properties,'$.length') AS length,
       json_extract(f.properties,'$.product_type') AS product_type,
       COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, -1) AS available_today_quantity
FROM fam f
LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=f.product_sku AND si.store_id='store_vienna_meidling'
ORDER BY f.brand, f.product_sku
LIMIT 500;

WITH req AS (
  SELECT 'P1' AS pid, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_variant_properties f ON f.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND f.property_key='fastener_type' AND lower(f.property_value_text)='bolt'
  JOIN product_variant_properties d ON d.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND d.property_key='diameter_mm' AND (d.property_value_number=10 OR d.property_value_text='10')
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND si.store_id='store_innsbruck_wilten'
  WHERE pv.brand='Heco' AND pv.series='Zinc Plated' AND pv.model='HECO 3DW-64B' AND pv.product_name LIKE '%Nut Bolt and Washer%'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P2' AS pid, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_variant_properties c ON c.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND c.property_key='cleaner_type' AND lower(c.property_value_text)='degreaser'
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND si.store_id='store_innsbruck_wilten'
  WHERE pv.brand='Ajax' AND pv.series='Eco' AND pv.model='Classic 25C-DXE' AND pv.product_name LIKE '%Cleaning Liquid%'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P3' AS pid, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_variant_properties s ON s.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND s.property_key='screw_type' AND lower(s.property_value_text)='drywall screw'
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND si.store_id='store_innsbruck_wilten'
  WHERE pv.brand='Heco' AND pv.series='Zinc Plated' AND pv.model='TopFix GTU-YPJ' AND pv.product_name LIKE '%Wood and Drywall Screw%'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P4' AS pid, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_variant_properties s ON s.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND s.property_key='screw_type' AND lower(s.property_value_text)='wood screw'
  JOIN product_variant_properties d ON d.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND d.property_key='diameter_mm' AND (d.property_value_number=3 OR d.property_value_text='3')
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND si.store_id='store_innsbruck_wilten'
  WHERE pv.brand='Heco' AND pv.series='Zinc Plated' AND pv.model='TopFix GTU-YPJ' AND pv.product_name LIKE '%Wood and Drywall Screw%'
)
SELECT pid, product_sku, record_path, available_today_quantity,
       CASE WHEN available_today_quantity >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qualifies
FROM req
ORDER BY pid;

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

WITH req(req_id, brand, series, model, product_name, attr1_k, attr1_v, attr2_k, attr2_v) AS (
  VALUES
  ('P1','Heco','Heco Zinc Plated','HECO 3DW-64B','Nut Bolt and Washer','fastener_type','bolt','diameter_mm','10'),
  ('P2','Ajax','Ajax Eco Classic','25C-DXE','Cleaning Liquid','cleaner_type','degreaser',NULL,NULL),
  ('P3','Heco','Heco Zinc Plated TopFix','GTU-YPJ','Wood and Drywall Screw','screw_type','drywall screw',NULL,NULL),
  ('P4','Heco','Heco Zinc Plated TopFix','GTU-YPJ','Wood and Drywall Screw','screw_type','wood screw','diameter_mm','3')
), candidates AS (
  SELECT r.req_id, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM req r
  JOIN product_variants pv
    ON pv.brand = r.brand
   AND pv.series = r.series
   AND pv.model = r.model
   AND pv.product_name = r.product_name
  JOIN product_variant_properties p1
    ON p1.product_sku = pv.product_sku
   AND p1.property_key = r.attr1_k
   AND (LOWER(REPLACE(p1.property_value_text,' ','')) = LOWER(REPLACE(r.attr1_v,' ',''))
        OR CAST(p1.property_value_number AS TEXT) = r.attr1_v)
  LEFT JOIN product_variant_properties p2
    ON p2.product_sku = pv.product_sku
   AND r.attr2_k IS NOT NULL
   AND p2.property_key = r.attr2_k
   AND (LOWER(REPLACE(p2.property_value_text,' ','')) = LOWER(REPLACE(r.attr2_v,' ',''))
        OR CAST(p2.property_value_number AS TEXT) = r.attr2_v)
  JOIN store_inventory si
    ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
   AND si.store_id = 'store_innsbruck_wilten'
  WHERE r.attr2_k IS NULL OR p2.product_sku IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT req_id, product_sku, record_path, available_today_quantity
FROM candidates
ORDER BY req_id, product_sku;

table,customer_accounts,"CREATE TABLE customer_accounts (

table,payment_transaction_items,"CREATE TABLE payment_transaction_items (

table,payment_transactions,"CREATE TABLE payment_transactions (

table,product_categories,"CREATE TABLE product_categories (

table,product_families,"CREATE TABLE product_families (

table,product_kinds,"CREATE TABLE product_kinds (

table,product_variant_properties,"CREATE TABLE product_variant_properties (

table,product_variants,"CREATE TABLE product_variants (

	series TEXT NOT NULL,

	price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,

)"
table,return_requests,"CREATE TABLE return_requests (
	return_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	record_path TEXT NOT NULL,
	basket_id TEXT NOT NULL,

	payment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	return_status TEXT NOT NULL,

table,shopping_basket_items,"CREATE TABLE shopping_basket_items (

table,shopping_baskets,"CREATE TABLE shopping_baskets (

table,store_inventory,"CREATE TABLE store_inventory (

table,stores,"CREATE TABLE stores (

WITH target_store AS (
  SELECT 'store_vienna_meidling' AS store_id
),
q1 AS (
  SELECT 'P1' AS product_key, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id=si.store_id
  WHERE pv.brand='Karcher' AND pv.series='Karcher WD SC' AND pv.model='1PM-1UM'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='cleaner_type' AND lower(p.property_value_text)='degreaser')
),
q2 AS (
  SELECT 'P2' AS product_key, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id=si.store_id
  WHERE pv.brand='Pattex' AND pv.series='Pattex Universal Repair' AND pv.model='56O-393'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='sealant_type' AND lower(p.property_value_text)='silicone sealant')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='color_family' AND lower(p.property_value_text)='clear')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='volume' AND (lower(p.property_value_text)='280 ml' OR lower(p.property_value_text)='280ml'))
),
q3 AS (
  SELECT 'P3' AS product_key, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id=si.store_id
  WHERE pv.brand='Helios' AND pv.series='Helios Quick Dry Mobihel' AND pv.model='1VV-8Y1'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='color_family' AND lower(p.property_value_text)='black')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='finish' AND lower(p.property_value_text)='satin')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='volume' AND (lower(p.property_value_text)='2500 ml' OR lower(p.property_value_text)='2500ml'))
),
q4 AS (
  SELECT 'P4' AS product_key, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id=si.store_id
  WHERE pv.brand='Osram' AND pv.series='Osram Eco Classic' AND pv.model='3PW-R88'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='wattage' AND (lower(p.property_value_text)='4 w' OR lower(p.property_value_text)='4w'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='luminous_flux' AND (lower(p.property_value_text)='806 lm' OR lower(p.property_value_text)='806lm'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='fitting' AND lower(p.property_value_text)='e27')
),
q5 AS (
  SELECT 'P5' AS product_key, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id=si.store_id
  WHERE pv.brand='Wurth' AND pv.series='Wurth Universal WU' AND pv.model='30Y-BPU'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='fastener_type' AND lower(p.property_value_text)='threaded rod')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='diameter' AND (lower(p.property_value_text)='6 mm' OR lower(p.property_value_text)='6mm'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='length' AND (lower(p.property_value_text)='40 mm' OR lower(p.property_value_text)='40mm'))
),
q6 AS (
  SELECT 'P6' AS product_key, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id=si.store_id
  WHERE pv.brand='Tesa' AND pv.series='Tesa Powerbond Powerbond' AND pv.model='1RD-FPW'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='product_type' AND lower(p.property_value_text)='construction foam')
)

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

WITH target_store AS (SELECT 'store_vienna_meidling' AS store_id),
req(product_key, brand, series, model, must1, must2, must3) AS (
  VALUES
  ('P1','Karcher','WD','SC 1PM-1UM','Cleaning Liquid','degreaser',NULL),
  ('P2','Pattex','Universal','Repair 56O-393','Sealant','silicone sealant','Clear 280ml'),
  ('P3','Helios','Quick Dry','Mobihel 1VV-8Y1','Wall Paint','Black satin','2500ml'),
  ('P4','Osram','Eco','Classic 3PW-R88','LED Bulb','E27 4W','806'),
  ('P5','Wurth','Universal','WU 30Y-BPU','Nut Bolt and Washer','threaded rod 6mm','40mm'),
  ('P6','Tesa','Powerbond','Powerbond 1RD-FPW','Tape and Foam','construction foam',NULL)
),
matches AS (
  SELECT r.product_key, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.product_name,
         si.available_today_quantity,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY r.product_key
           ORDER BY COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity,-1) DESC, pv.product_sku
         ) AS rn
  FROM req r
  JOIN product_variants pv
    ON pv.brand=r.brand AND pv.series=r.series AND pv.model=r.model
  LEFT JOIN store_inventory si
    ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND si.store_id=(SELECT store_id FROM target_store)
  WHERE pv.product_name LIKE '%'||r.must1||'%'
    AND pv.product_name LIKE '%'||r.must2||'%'
    AND (r.must3 IS NULL OR pv.product_name LIKE '%'||r.must3||'%')
)
SELECT r.product_key,
       m.product_sku,
       m.record_path,
       m.product_name,
       m.available_today_quantity,
       CASE WHEN m.available_today_quantity >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qualifies
FROM req r
LEFT JOIN matches m ON m.product_key=r.product_key AND m.rn=1
ORDER BY r.product_key;

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

  JOIN product_variants pv ON lower(pv.brand)=lower(t.brand)
    AND lower(pv.model)=lower(t.model)
    AND lower(pv.series) LIKE '%'||lower(t.series_token)||'%'
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id=pv.product_kind_id AND lower(pk.product_kind_name)=lower(t.kind_name)
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND si.store_id='store_innsbruck_wilten'
  LEFT JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku=pv.product_sku
  GROUP BY t.pid, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, si.available_today_quantity, t.a3k
), matched AS (
  SELECT * FROM candidates WHERE m1=1 AND m2=1 AND m3=1
), per_product AS (
  SELECT pid, MAX(available_today_quantity) AS best_avail
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY pid
)
SELECT t.pid,
       COALESCE(pp.best_avail, -1) AS best_avail,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(pp.best_avail,0) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qualifies
FROM targets t
LEFT JOIN per_product pp ON pp.pid=t.pid
ORDER BY t.pid;

WITH target_store AS (
  SELECT 'store_vienna_meidling' AS store_id
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'P1_cleaning_liquid' AS item,
         pv.product_sku,
         pv.record_path,
         si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON p1.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p1.property_key='cleaner_type' AND lower(p1.property_value_text)='degreaser'
  WHERE pv.brand='Karcher' AND pv.series='Karcher WD SC' AND pv.model='1PM-1UM' AND pv.product_kind_id='cleaning_liquid'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P2_sealant' AS item,
         pv.product_sku,
         pv.record_path,
         si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON p1.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p1.property_key='sealant_type' AND lower(p1.property_value_text)='silicone sealant'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p2 ON p2.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p2.property_key='color_family' AND lower(p2.property_value_text)='clear'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p3 ON p3.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p3.property_key='volume_ml' AND CAST(p3.property_value_number AS INTEGER)=280
  WHERE pv.brand='Pattex' AND pv.series='Pattex Universal Repair' AND pv.model='56O-393' AND pv.product_kind_id='sealant'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P3_wall_paint' AS item,
         pv.product_sku,
         pv.record_path,
         si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON p1.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p1.property_key='color_family' AND lower(p1.property_value_text)='black'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p2 ON p2.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p2.property_key='finish' AND lower(p2.property_value_text)='satin'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p3 ON p3.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p3.property_key='volume_ml' AND CAST(p3.property_value_number AS INTEGER)=2500
  WHERE pv.brand='Helios' AND pv.series='Helios Quick Dry Mobihel' AND pv.model='1VV-8Y1' AND pv.product_kind_id='wall_paint'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P4_led_bulb' AS item,
         pv.product_sku,
         pv.record_path,
         si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON p1.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p1.property_key='wattage_w' AND CAST(p1.property_value_number AS INTEGER)=4
  JOIN product_variant_properties p2 ON p2.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p2.property_key='luminous_flux_lm' AND CAST(p2.property_value_number AS INTEGER)=806
  JOIN product_variant_properties p3 ON p3.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p3.property_key='fitting' AND upper(p3.property_value_text)='E27'
  WHERE pv.brand='Osram' AND pv.series='Osram Eco Classic' AND pv.model='3PW-R88' AND pv.product_kind_id='led_bulb'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P5_nut_bolt_washer' AS item,
         pv.product_sku,
         pv.record_path,
         si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON p1.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p1.property_key='fastener_type' AND lower(p1.property_value_text)='threaded rod'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p2 ON p2.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p2.property_key='diameter_mm' AND CAST(p2.property_value_number AS INTEGER)=6
  JOIN product_variant_properties p3 ON p3.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p3.property_key='length_mm' AND CAST(p3.property_value_number AS INTEGER)=40
  WHERE pv.brand='Wurth' AND pv.series='Wurth Universal WU' AND pv.model='30Y-BPU' AND pv.product_kind_id='nut_bolt_washer'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'P6_tape_foam' AS item,
         pv.product_sku,
         pv.record_path,
         si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  JOIN target_store ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON p1.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p1.property_key='product_type' AND lower(p1.property_value_text)='construction foam'
  WHERE pv.brand='Tesa' AND pv.series='Tesa Powerbond Powerbond' AND pv.model='1RD-FPW' AND pv.product_kind_id='tape_foam'
) q
ORDER BY item, product_sku;

WITH matched AS (
  -- P1 Pattex XQS-RSC adhesive type threadlocker color Brown
  SELECT 'P1' pid, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id=pv.product_kind_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON p1.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p1.property_key)='adhesive type' AND lower(p1.property_value_text)='threadlocker'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p2 ON p2.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p2.property_key)='color family' AND lower(p2.property_value_text)='brown'
  WHERE lower(pv.brand)='pattex' AND lower(pv.series) LIKE '%pattex crystal px%' AND lower(pv.model) LIKE '%xqs-rsc%' AND lower(pk.product_kind_name)='adhesive and glue'

  UNION ALL
  -- P2 Den Braven DB 1FQ-XIS hybrid sealant clear
  SELECT 'P2', pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id=pv.product_kind_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON p1.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p1.property_key)='sealant type' AND lower(p1.property_value_text)='hybrid sealant'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p2 ON p2.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p2.property_key)='color family' AND lower(p2.property_value_text)='clear'
  WHERE lower(pv.brand)='den braven' AND lower(pv.series) LIKE '%professional%' AND lower(pv.model) LIKE '%1fq-xis%' AND lower(pk.product_kind_name)='sealant'

  UNION ALL
  -- P3 Grohe 1BM-CHH faucet connector 15 mm M24
  SELECT 'P3', pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id=pv.product_kind_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON p1.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p1.property_key)='connector type' AND lower(p1.property_value_text)='faucet connector'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p2 ON p2.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p2.property_key)='diameter' AND lower(replace(p2.property_value_text,' ',''))='15mm'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p3 ON p3.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p3.property_key)='thread type' AND lower(p3.property_value_text)='m24'
  WHERE lower(pv.brand)='grohe' AND lower(pv.series) LIKE '%quickfix essence%' AND lower(pv.model) LIKE '%1bm-chh%' AND lower(pk.product_kind_name)='valve and connector'

  UNION ALL
  -- P4 Makita 3BS-NF1 18V 18v-system two battery kit
  SELECT 'P4', pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id=pv.product_kind_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON p1.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p1.property_key)='voltage' AND lower(replace(p1.property_value_text,' ',''))='18v'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p2 ON p2.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p2.property_key)='battery platform' AND lower(p2.property_value_text)='18v-system'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p3 ON p3.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p3.property_key)='kit contents' AND lower(p3.property_value_text)='two battery kit'
  WHERE lower(pv.brand)='makita' AND lower(pv.series) LIKE '%lxt ddf%' AND lower(pv.model) LIKE '%3bs-nf1%' AND lower(pk.product_kind_name)='cordless drill driver'

  UNION ALL
  -- P5 Loctite DZ6-M5M epoxy white
  SELECT 'P5', pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id=pv.product_kind_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON p1.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p1.property_key)='adhesive type' AND lower(p1.property_value_text)='epoxy'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p2 ON p2.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p2.property_key)='color family' AND lower(p2.property_value_text)='white'
  WHERE lower(pv.brand)='loctite' AND lower(pv.series) LIKE '%threadlocker 401%' AND lower(pv.model) LIKE '%dz6-m5m%' AND lower(pk.product_kind_name)='adhesive and glue'

  UNION ALL

  FROM product_variants pv

  JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON p1.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p1.property_key)='adhesive type' AND lower(p1.property_value_text)='epoxy'
  JOIN product_variant_properties p2 ON p2.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND lower(p2.property_key)='color family' AND lower(p2.property_value_text)='brown'
  WHERE lower(pv.brand)='ceresit' AND lower(pv.series)='cm' AND lower(pv.model) LIKE '%3w5-dsz%' AND lower(pk.product_kind_name)='adhesive and glue'
)

FROM product_variants
WHERE lower(model) LIKE '%xqs-rsc%'
   OR lower(model) LIKE '%1fq-xis%'
   OR lower(model) LIKE '%1bm-chh%'
   OR lower(model) LIKE '%3bs-nf1%'
   OR lower(model) LIKE '%dz6-m5m%'
   OR lower(model) LIKE '%3w5-dsz%'
ORDER BY brand, model, product_sku
LIMIT 500;

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

request.stdin:
WITH variants AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.brand, pv.series, pv.model, lower(pv.product_name) AS pn,
         si.available_today_quantity
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND si.store_id='store_innsbruck_wilten'
  WHERE lower(pv.model) LIKE '%xqs-rsc%'
     OR lower(pv.model) LIKE '%1fq-xis%'
     OR lower(pv.model) LIKE '%1bm-chh%'
     OR lower(pv.model) LIKE '%3bs-nf1%'
     OR lower(pv.model) LIKE '%dz6-m5m%'
     OR lower(pv.model) LIKE '%3w5-dsz%'
), matched AS (
  SELECT 'P1' pid, * FROM variants WHERE lower(brand)='pattex' AND lower(series) LIKE '%crystal%' AND lower(model) LIKE '%xqs-rsc%' AND pn LIKE '%adhesive and glue%' AND pn LIKE '%threadlocker%' AND pn LIKE '%brown%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'P2' pid, * FROM variants WHERE lower(brand)='den braven' AND lower(model) LIKE '%1fq-xis%' AND pn LIKE '%sealant%' AND pn LIKE '%hybrid sealant%' AND pn LIKE '%clear%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'P3' pid, * FROM variants WHERE lower(brand)='grohe' AND lower(model) LIKE '%1bm-chh%' AND pn LIKE '%valve and connector%' AND pn LIKE '%faucet connector%' AND (pn LIKE '%15mm%' OR pn LIKE '%15 mm%') AND pn LIKE '%m24%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'P4' pid, * FROM variants WHERE lower(brand)='makita' AND lower(model) LIKE '%3bs-nf1%' AND pn LIKE '%cordless drill driver%' AND (pn LIKE '%18v%' OR pn LIKE '%18 v%') AND pn LIKE '%two battery kit%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'P5' pid, * FROM variants WHERE lower(brand)='loctite' AND lower(model) LIKE '%dz6-m5m%' AND pn LIKE '%adhesive and glue%' AND pn LIKE '%epoxy%' AND pn LIKE '%white%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'P6' pid, * FROM variants WHERE lower(brand)='ceresit' AND lower(model) LIKE '%3w5-dsz%' AND pn LIKE '%adhesive and glue%' AND pn LIKE '%epoxy%' AND pn LIKE '%brown%'
)
SELECT pid, product_sku, record_path, available_today_quantity,
       CASE WHEN available_today_quantity>=4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qualifies
FROM matched
ORDER BY pid, available_today_quantity DESC;

SELECT brand, series, model, product_sku, record_path, product_name, product_kind_id, properties
FROM product_variants
WHERE brand IN ('Pattex','Tesa','Wurth')
ORDER BY brand, series, model, product_sku
LIMIT 300;

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially

- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

# Founding principles of Agentic E-Commerce OS System (v2/PROD)


0. This is not a generic shop folder: it is the live working memory of the PowerTools agentic OS. Every employee, contractor, and assistant touching this system should prioritize a bandwidth-aligned review of the creation story at [/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md](/docs/powertools-agentic-os-origin-story.md) so the legacy is not accidentally flattened into mere procedure.
1. readme.md files take role of agents.md. Trust them, follow the chain of command.
2. All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).

## Key locations

- Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
- Employee profiles are in proc/employees
- Customer profiles are in proc/customers, baskets are in proc/baskets, payments are in proc/payments
- Tools are in `/bin`, they have `--help` arg to describe capabilities especially 
- Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security

## Important tools

- see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Query `sqlite_schema` to see the schema, for example `/bin/sql 'select name, sql from sqlite_schema where sql is not null order by type, name;'`. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
- id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
- use discount tool to manage basket discounts
- use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization

## Important things

- When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
- When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
- When a request is ambiguous and you ask for clarification, reference all concrete candidate objects that make it ambiguous.
- When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
- When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
- When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context
